apps.localizedDescription:
AltStore is an alternative app store for non-jailbroken devices. 

This beta release of AltStore adds support for 3rd party sources, allowing you to download apps from other developers directly through AltStore.

versions.localizedDescription:
This update fixes 503 and -80046 errors when sideloading and refreshing apps.

⚠️ You may need to manually install this update by re-installing AltStore with AltServer. You do NOT need to delete AltStore first.

This update fixes error -80045 when sideloading and refreshing apps.

⚠️ You may need to manually install this update by re-installing AltStore with AltServer. You do NOT need to delete AltStore first.

NEW

Randomize Bundle IDs
• New experimental feature in AltStore’s settings
• Randomizes bundle IDs for sideloaded apps

IMPROVED
• Improved error messages for common Remote AltServer connection issues

FIXED
• Fixed 2FA codes not appearing when signing in (thanks @IgoSzaFIIT!)
• Fixed "BGTaskSchedulerErrorDomain error 3" alert when setting up Remote AltServer on iOS 27+
• Fixed apps not refreshing in background
• Fixed asking to sign-in before setting up Remote AltServer
